The *Ācāmadāyikāvimānavatthu* (Vv 20) is a canonical verse text belonging to the *Vimānavatthu* in the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. In this discourse, the deity Sakka questions the arahant Kassapa concerning a woman who had previously offered alms to him [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records six translations of the text across six modern languages [SuttaCentral].
No curated parallel versions are identified on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus also records a low-plausibility automatic cross-language match with the Tibetan translation of the *Ārya-bodhisattvapiṭaka-nāma-mahāyānasūtra* (D0056) [DharmaNexus].
